1.why: All five screens use a clean sans-serif typeface with comfortable line and letter spacing, including the multi-line banners and the step-4 paragraph.

2.why: No italics or all-caps text appear anywhere and all copy is sentence case, though the step-4 'Evaluation behavior' paragraph is a moderately sized block.

3.why: Every screen is a single centred column card with full-width fields and large buttons, a layout that remains readable and well ordered at mobile widths.

4.why: Instructions such as 'We sent a six-digit verification code to your registered contact method' and 'Add this secret to your authenticator app' are short plain sentences.

5.why: The phone field shows a '+1 555 010 0184' placeholder and a mock code '037020' is displayed, but the email and six-digit authenticator fields provide no example of expected input.

6.why: The longest passage is the four-line explanation on the authenticator setup screen; all other steps require reading only a one- or two-line banner.

7.why: The manual setup secret 'JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP' is rendered as ordinary selectable text in a box, so it can be copied, although no dedicated copy button is offered.

8.why: No QR code, otpauth link, or any alternative to manual entry appears on the authenticator setup screen — only a typed manual secret is provided.

9.why: The screenshots show standard labelled text inputs but contain no observable evidence (autocomplete attributes, password-manager prompts) confirming that autofill or password managers are supported.

10.why: Each screen has a bold heading naming the current step and a prominent blue primary button, though there is no step-of-total indicator and the logs panel competes for attention.

11.why: Each step asks for one main action (Continue, Verify identity, Set up/Activate authenticator), with 'Sign out' and 'Back to settings' present only as secondary options.

12.why: Transitions confirm outcomes (code sent, 'Authenticator not enabled' status shown), but the error 'Verification could not be completed' does not state what happened or what comes next.

13.why: After the rejected code the form remains available for another attempt with no penalty shown, but there is no resend-code option and no reveal/hide control for the secret.

14.why: The only error message, 'Verification could not be completed,' neither states the specific problem nor how to fix it, although it does not blame the user.

15.why: The verification code 'expires in five minutes' and the TOTP codes run on 30-second windows, so explicit time limits on code entry exist even though no reading timer is imposed.
